messages:
Marta (security): Heads up team — rolling out the updated 'On-Prem Data Access & Audit Scoping' guidance to the KB. This clarifies what telemetry is collected for Private/VPC installs and introduces a scoped-audit mode customers can enable to reduce sensitive context in logs. Link: https://internal.kb/redwood/onprem-audit-scoping

Devon (product): TL;DR for sales/CS: toggling scoped-audit reduces network payloads in logs (no full prompt bodies) but retains token-level metrics and error traces so we can still SLA troubleshoot. Good for regulated customers.

Rhea (customer-success): Nice. Can we get a one-pager we can send to customers? Also include instructions for customers who use our managed support bundle vs customers who self-host.

Marta (security): Yes — one-pager is attached to the KB. Two modes: `full-audit` (default), `scoped-audit` (redacts user-provided text from logs, preserves metadata + anonymized token counts). Switching is opt-in via cluster config.

Kai (eng-sre): Implementation notes: agent exposes `audit.mode` in values.yaml and a new endpoint `/audit/health`. When `scoped-audit` is enabled the agent will strip `prompt` and `response` fields from telemetry payloads before upload. Sample diff in the doc.

```
# values.yaml
audit:
  mode: scoped-audit  # options: full-audit | scoped-audit
```

Devon (product): Are there any compatibility caveats with existing monitoring integrations (Datadog, Splunk)?

Kai (eng-sre): Short answer: for the most part no. We ship an adapter that maps anonymized fields to the same metric names. Caveat: some customers ingest raw payloads via our forwarder; they'll need to update parsing rules. We added migration scripts.

Owen (legal): Reviewed. Please amend the privacy section to make the data retention window explicit for EU/UK customers and add contract language for customers who want audit logs disabled entirely. I'll add suggested wording to the KB tomorrow.

audit-bot: KB updated: /kb/onprem-audit-scoping-2026-03-23 — reviewers: eng-sre, security, legal, customer-success

Rhea (customer-success): Scheduling two office hours next week for pilot customers (Mon 9am PT, Wed 3pm PT). I'll drop invites to #customer-success and post a short FAQ.

Marta (security): Action items: (1) @Owen finalize EU wording by Tue EOD, (2) @Kai publish the healthcheck API spec + sample curl, (3) @Devon prepare the CS one-pager and email template. Please react with :white_check_mark: when done.

Devon (product): Acked. I'll also add a note in the release notes about potential parsing updates for forwarder customers.

Kai (eng-sre): Adding PR with the agent change now. Will tag eng-oncall for visibility.

Marta (security): Thanks. This should help a lot with conversations for regulated prospects.
